key.name: video-codec
key.description: The video codec used for encoding: vp8, vp9, h264, h265, or av1.

key.name: container-format
key.description: Container file format: webm, mp4, or mkv.

key.name: layout-preset
key.description: Recording layout preset: desktop-pip, side-by-side, screen-only, or camera-only.

key.name: webcam-shape
key.description: Shape mask for webcam: rectangle, square, or circle.

key.name: webcam-pos-x
key.description: Normalized horizontal position of the webcam overlay (0.0 to 1.0).

key.name: webcam-pos-y
key.description: Normalized vertical position of the webcam overlay (0.0 to 1.0).

key.name: webcam-scale
key.description: Scale factor of webcam overlay relative to the screen width (0.1 to 0.65).

key.name: countdown-seconds
key.description: Delay in seconds before recording begins (0 to 300).

key.name: custom-countdown-seconds
key.description: Remembered custom countdown duration in seconds.

key.name: mic-enabled
key.description: Whether microphone audio capture is active.

key.name: gpu-compositing
key.description: Prefer GStreamer OpenGL compositor (glvideomixer) when available.

key.name: enabled-cameras
key.description: List of enabled camera device identifiers (empty = auto-select first available).

key.name: enabled-microphones
key.description: List of enabled microphone source identifiers (empty = default system microphone).

key.name: shortcut-start-stop
key.description: Global keyboard shortcut to start or stop recording.

key.name: shortcut-pause
key.description: Global keyboard shortcut to pause or resume recording.
